display_long_description:
The G.J. Gardner Homes NZ app enables users to explore a range of G.J. Gardner’s most popular house designs in an immersive, hands-on manner. Virtual Reality enables users to walk-through designs across a range of sizes and specifications, allowing them to get a feel for the flow of the space and better understand the layout of the design. Helping them to find the home that suits their wants and needs.

G.J. Gardner Homes is New Zealand’s Most Trusted Home Builder, having built over 23,000 homes in New Zealand since 1997. Locally owned and operated franchises across New Zealand, work with local trades to build quality homes that are designed to meet individual customer’s needs.

The Plan Range compiles many of GJ’s most popular designs, across a range of sizes and specifications. Providing home buyers with a range of designs to select from, or a foundation to build on to make the design their own.
